newsitem.title: GREECE: SARANDOPOULOS CONVERTIBLE BOND ISSUE COVERED.
newsitem.headline: SARANDOPOULOS CONVERTIBLE BOND ISSUE COVERED.

text.p: K.I.Sarandopoulos' 2.52 billion drachma convertible bond issue which will finance the its participation in the Rio-Antirio bridge and Elefsis- Stavros-Spata highway projects was fully covered, it said.

The construction company issued 1,445,310 five-year convertible bonds with a fixed 9.0 percent coupon which will be listed on the Athens bourse. The minimum trading lot will be 10 bonds and the par value is 900 drachmas.
Each bond may be converted to one share at 2,100 drachmas any time during the five-year period.
Shareholders who opt for conversion into shares will have to pay the company 350 drachmas -- the difference between the conversion price and the issue price of 1,750 drachmas.
The convertibles are callable one year after the issue date, January 13, 1997, if the shares exceed a market price of 3,000 drachmas.
Corporate convertible bonds are subject to a tax rate of 20 percent. Thus the net yield on the bonds will be 7.2 percent.
Shares of K.I.Sarandopoulos closed up 10 drachmas at 1,675 on Monday. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
